folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B344: complete owner and local causal scope
folds.body:
All296 original lines were reviewed, including every evidence/baseline/continuity/acquisition/transfer table, six worked altered-anchor patterns, rival and loss policies, three comic comparisons, LC1–LC5, historical checks and later Paradise outcome. Preserve the good promise: a pinned branch starts from its inspected snapshot and follows actual causes. A source endpoint, official collection page or completed publication does not establish a whole franchise audit or force an intervened world to recover the same ending. An adaptation corroborates itself, not an unchecked original-manga mechanism.

The old five-world priority and one-realm/one-prestige milestone are superseded by later direction. Current Klein/Harry developer work remains governed by PROJECT and AD44; comic rankings and the dormant specialist reservation do not launch new worlds or workers. The six continuity promises and record names remain design contracts, not six confirmed native APIs. The selected forced-canon developer run can hold source results while its state matches; this is a mode policy alongside ordinary causal divergence, not evidence that every actor or source world has cosmic plot protection.

Canon-compatible gaps, explicit changes, earlier snapshots, parallel counterparts, post-ending continuations and actual travel/overlap need different histories and carriers. An earlier authored instance does not automatically repair another world's loss, but a real regression/overlap mechanism may affect its declared scope. Similar names do not transfer memories, rank, debts or bonds; a valid resonance or identity mechanism may. A late publication can inform a future contract without silently rewriting committed past state. Frozen revision alone does not retain the old generator/content or prove save compatibility.

Actual institution resources, observer beliefs, witness routes and source expectations remain separate. A warning can change a plan, and the original attacker need not acquire a substitute victim or unlimited resources to force its scene. A rival can adapt, bargain, stop or become stronger through real means. A source-supported compelling or memory-changing faculty can affect choices where its actual law allows; ordinary cooperation, recognition or rescue does not automatically imply permanent loyalty. Source-bound copying/body/soul claims require the chosen actual passages; the bounded ledgers and official pages cited here were not reopened.

The default death-final and finite/costed-recovery/duplicate-counterpart language is local proposed policy, not a universal world law. Current recovery/end defaults, actual source mechanisms and AD50/AD22 govern a chosen threat. A genuinely free or repeatable revival/creation route can work without a balancing price. A new actual counterpart/source can supply distinct goods under its world rules; protect one committed claim from double settlement without inventing a campaign-wide ban on legitimate acquisition. A teacher's death can end that teacher's current instruction while actual records, spirits, prior copies or a supported restoration offer their own routes. Do not infer every relevant cause from a generic event label.

The known permission/appearance/actual-function distinctions remain useful. Sufficient force may break an institution's physical barrier without conferring legal office; a genuinely authority-changing power can do more if its actual rules supply it. Shared rules can coexist with different bodies, local resources and jurisdiction. AD51 supports useful shared semantics rather than a universal scalar, and AD52 permits compressed work/aftermath with actual actors, costs, order, knowledge and custody preserved.

All old fetched/indexed-page checks, URLs, unavailable-source statements, fingerprint comparisons,33links/55URLs and no-current-world-adapter findings retain their historical scopes. The final Paradise section narrows a later implemented-unverified local application; it does not turn19contracts into full worlds, general NPC targeting or freshly passed native/save proof. Generic human acceptance remains optional under AD42, while actual selected runtime/persistence/source gaps remain. This reconciliation changed no source snapshot, death policy, branch, personal save, worker, canon claim or gameplay behavior.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B344: complete owner and local causal scope
folds.body:
All259 original lines were reviewed, including the existing live-routing correction, historical five-world roster, composition fields, all responsibility/plot/failure/transfer rows, JSON example, power fixtures, Wayfarer proposal, runtime fit and both design reviews through GW1–GW5. The opening already retires the October3 milestone, roster and capacity as live authority; preserve it and do not revive the later historical second-world-after-milestone gate. Current LOTM-first/Klein and Harry developer work, accepted WER and lead-life owners govern selection.

The useful authoring composition distinguishes world/source family, actual history/instance, era, region, entry, situation, local means, failure and transfer. Names such as WorldDefinition are proposals, not exported APIs or new save fields. A JSON example parsing does not prove a playable composition. A later concrete local instance can coexist with missing general adapters; the historical no-native-instance label is not a current global absence claim. Keep actual shared state/custody/clock authority and bind only a selected meaningful consumer under AD51.

Different modes alter real causes rather than creating several plot or reward stores. An issuer's settled objective can succeed while a region loses, and refusing a mission creates no accepted debt. Genuine coercion or world obligations can still exist through actual means. A prior witness's changed action, access or resource should remain changed rather than being replaced to force a scene. Hidden objectives do not retroactively become known agreed terms. The named Wayfarer cast and encounter counts are original proposals, not source facts, present NPC availability or a new mandatory hub.

Local threat and actual target/contact/support matter more than a shared rank. The three calibration fixtures remain specified-not-run. A powerful import can make a problem easy, and losing one support need not erase its ownership or independent uses. “Only at a cost”, mandatory maintenance/refit effort and limits on repeated parallel-instance goods are examples, not universal taxes. A distinct new instance may legitimately contain a different actual counterpart item; a repeated request on the same committed operation cannot pay twice. AD22 protects save integrity without nerfing a supported strong or profitable route.

The harsh-world table preserves actual defeat/body death/mission failure/visit interruption/life end/prestige/history distinctions. No universal immunity or escape is promised, but neither does this palette enable silent permadeath or offline losses. A world rule can contain hazards without a separate per-action voluntary Heat switch; known terms and available character evidence determine disclosure. Actual partial work, unfinished commitments and stock custody need settlement on an interrupted crossing. The old safe-boundary planner statement is a source observation of that revision, not proof no present kidnapping/interruption route exists.

Current journey-wide eligible unused-time banking qualifies time-banking-as-unselected text; actual spending means, world clocks and supported production remain separate. A default freeze record is not proof all absence adapters exist or that every source world uses it. AD52 can compress repeat work and chapter spans without losing causal consequences or limiting total play length. Generic human fiction/feel review is optional under AD42, while runtime/source/new-state persistence and task-specific compatibility need actual evidence.

The linked campaigns, eight-file packs,53families/15loadouts/fiveassemblies,1122links/365anchors and source fingerprints retain their recorded review scope. No complete source catalogue, numerical balance or runtime behavior follows from those counts. The top note's current-source recovery direction already supersedes the historical reservation/cursor next steps; they do not create active workers or current commit rights. No new campaign, instance, failure mode, source fact, runtime adapter, live trial or gameplay acceptance was produced by this full owner read.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B344: complete owner and local causal scope
folds.body:
All174 original lines were reviewed, including every progression dimension, module field group, assembly/granularity table, tier track, operating example, craft/refit/loadout contract, runtime limits, checkpoint and three GW3 follow-ups. Preserve distinct mastery, structure, quality, condition, source/body, institutional rank and knowledge. One can change a useful capacity or control without changing every other axis or literally adding a new verb. A local tier does not automatically equal another world's rank; a source-defined stage needs actual evidence.

The six-context/five-path/three-build/eight-module minima and five-world roster describe the historical design assignment, not universal requirements for every selected slice or source world. The old first milestone is no longer a gate. Current LOTM-first/Harry direction and AD51 govern delivery through the first useful justified seam; the entire graph, dynamic component inventory, every alternate path or full campaign dossier is not a prerequisite. A fixed item variant may prove its actual supported functions without pretending it is a general editable assembly system.

Definition, actual specimen, assembly, installed position, legal ownership and current custody remain different. A plan/loadout is not a second item copy, and repair/removal does not recreate a fresh object. Joint legal rights or an institution's ownership can differ from the single actual physical instance/holder; the one-component rule prevents accidental duplicate stock, not legitimate shared claims. A body-bound source cannot be made detachable merely by renaming it a module, but an actual transplantation/source-transfer mechanism can provide its own route. Selling borrowed stock may be possible through an authorized or actual theft route; the example's custody rejection does not prove physical impossibility across all worlds.

The eight-draw/twenty-four-reserve calculation correctly separates simultaneous demand from stored amount for that fictional channel. It is not universal physics: supply rate, reserve duration, startup, heat, control, authority and load can interact differently under actual local mechanisms. Two equal-rarity parts need not connect; a stronger valid source may legitimately satisfy all demand or remove heat/fuel needs. No residual weakness, second stabilizer, upkeep or safe workshop should be manufactured merely to preserve a tradeoff. Supported in-world duplication/creation need not pay an invented price; save integrity still prevents double publication of one operation.

A preview can inspect known compatibility without consuming the experiment. A paid test may change real parts, progress and knowledge; failure does not automatically mean all-or-nothing refund or useful evidence unless something was actually observed. Refit/salvage and overlapping jobs settle actual instance custody and partial work, with no double consume/return. Known safe processing may batch under AD52, and a routine can discover/refine through actual means. There is no mandatory manual-first grind, nine-timer chain or maximum campaign duration. Worker output and personally learned competence retain their actual producers and knowledge routes.

GW3's distinctions remain useful: compare full preparation as well as recurring use, and distinguish enduring proficiency/tool from finite charge/service. The Cyoria helper/device observations and tested-lamp maturity gap describe their inspected revision; a current alternate maturity route needs its actual consumer. They neither prove a whole non-device career exists nor select a requirement to merge every career. Stronger tools can make an older method obsolete; no forced equal reward/damage or niche is required.

All old current-source/typed-formula/no-graph-solver findings, module counts, completed specialist reservations and historical design checks retain their dates. No present runtime/source or installed graph was inspected by this review. A genuine UI claim needs the current rebuilt desktop route and relevant persistence evidence; generic human feel review is optional under AD42. No assembly schema, component, migration, source claim, reward, loadout or gameplay behavior was implemented here.
